text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert: routing tail latency spike detected in /v1/generate (p99 up ~7x over baseline). Impacting streaming sessions and batch endpoints. Pager triggered for oncall@eng-sre.

sanjay: seeing this too. p95 ~420ms -> 1.6s, p99 ~1.2s -> 8.6s. Streaming stalls frequently at token 0->1 for affected sessions.

maggie: logs show a surge of 503 from router LB (ingress-router-3). Pattern: sudden increase in misrouted shards to euw2-hotpool.

leo: confirmed—routing policy rollouts applied ~1736119800 (about 500s ago). policy: ingress-weight-adjust v5 (auto-rollout).

samir: can we pause the rollout? If it's the policy change, rolling back should stabilize.

dana: I'm on the rollout page. v5 changed affinity for small shard keys -> aggressive eager-fanout to nearby hot zones. That can overload hotpool and create backpressure.

erin: customer impact: 6 customers with streaming enabled in EU are reporting stalls and reconnects (support tickets #5481, #5483). Not widespread but severe for those tenants.

sanjay: repro traces attached from trace-id 0x7f9a:```
span router-eval ingress-router-3 -> chosen egress: euw2-hotpool
span egress-queue wait 1200ms
span worker-dequeue processing 5ms
span kv-cache miss
error: downstream timeout after 6s
```

maggie: traces show many requests routed to same egress group despite weight quotas. Looks like the new hash-affinity heuristic created hot partitions.

ops-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2. Paging: eng-sre oncall (sanjay) and runtime lead (maggie). Notify infra & support.

leo: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout v5, 2) emergency reweight to divert 80% traffic off euw2-hotpool, 3) temporarily disable eager-fanout for small keys.

samir: I'll pause rollout now. Command:```bash
redwoodctl rollout pause ingress-weight-adjust:v5 --namespace=global
redwoodctl rollout status ingress-weight-adjust:v5
```

dana: paused. rollout status: PAUSED (1736120120). Confirmed no new policy pushes.

maggie: executing emergency reweight. Command:```json
PATCH /internal/v1/routing/table
{ "rules": [{"match":"region:euw2","weight_delta":-0.8},{"match":"region:usw2","weight_delta":0.5}]}
```
apply took effect at 1736120263.

erin: support: informed impacted customers of degradation and we asked them to retry in 5-10m. CS escalated two high-priority tenants.

leo: also toggled eager-fanout off for small keys:```yaml
router.config:
  eager_fanout: false
  eager_fanout_threshold: 0 # disabled
``` applied to ingress-router-*. Change propagated at 1736120330.

samir: after reweight + fanout toggle, p95 back to ~380ms and p99 down to ~950ms. Streaming stalls reduced significantly.

ops-bot: Metric update: p99 for /v1/generate: 8.6s -> 1.0s over 4m. Error rate 503 -> 0.8%.

sanjay: good. We'll keep monitoring for 30m. Need oncall handoff in 20m to second shift. I'm going to create an incident bridge and do a live handoff.

maggie: opening bridge (zoom link...). I'll stay for handoff and do root-cause triage. Samir, can you take primary for the next 2h?

samir: can do. I'll document the exact mitigation steps in the incident doc.

dana: quick note—the policy logic bug: when key-cardinality < threshold, the heuristic rounded affinity bucket incorrectly, sending more shards to nearest-hotpool. Patch in review: fix hash normalization + add unit test for low-cardinality buckets.

erin: reported to CS: mitigation in place, some sessions restored, follow-up postmortem promised.

leo: next steps: postmortem, permanent rollback of v5 until fix is deployed, add canary guardrail to block eager-fanout changes from auto-rollout, add telemetry to detect hotpool skew earlier (alert on per-egress p99 ratio > 3x cluster p99).

samir: capturing action items: [1] revert v5 permanently, [2] deploy patch for hash normalization, [3] add canary guardrail + alert, [4] customer follow-up notes. I'll own 1 & 4. Maggie own 2. Leo own 3.

sanjay: handoff to samir now (oncall rotation). Leaving the bridge to you. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

samir: taking over. Updating status on the incident page and adding timelines. Will keep watch till 1736123745 then escalate if any regression.

ops-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents and pager ack recorded.

maggie: quick command snippets we used for the mitigation (for postmortem):```bash
# pause rollout
redwoodctl rollout pause ingress-weight-adjust:v5 --namespace=global
# emergency routing patch
redwoodctl patch /internal/v1/routing/table --file=routing-emergency-patch.json
# toggle fanout
redwoodctl set-config router.config eager_fanout=false
```

erin: closing loop with support: CS will follow up with impacted customers with timeline and offer warm-restart assistance.

samir: logging final note before monitoring: we saw clear correlation with the v5 config change. Root cause hypothesis: policy bug + hot partition amplification. Postmortem to include timeline and risk controls.

ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 at 1736120900. Monitoring only.

maggie: I'll open a postmortem PR and link logs/traces and the test case that proves the bug.

samir: thanks all. closing the bridge in 10m if metrics stay stable.

ops-bot: Bridge closed at 1736120945. Incident thread archived.
